import subprocess

# First, extract the OCTET STRING at offset 26 (the AuthenticatedSafe)
result = subprocess.run(['openssl', 'asn1parse', '-in', '/workspace/poc.p12', '-inform', 'DER', 
                        '-strparse', '26'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True)
print("AuthenticatedSafe:")
print(result.stdout)
print("STDERR:", result.stderr)
